scenes.text: This is what panthenol actually does for dry, tight skin.
scenes.head:
What panthenol
does for tight skin

scenes.text: When your skin is dry, the surface loses water. It feels tight and uncomfortable.
scenes.head:
Step 1
The surface feels tight

scenes.text: Panthenol is provitamin B5. It's a humectant: it draws water into the top layer.
scenes.head:
Step 2
It draws water in

scenes.text: Skin feels softer, calmer and more comfortable.
scenes.head:
Step 3
Skin feels calmer

scenes.text: On the label, look for panthenol or D-panthenol. Next episode: squalane.

caption:
What panthenol actually does for dry, tight skin 🫧
Panthenol is provitamin B5. It's a humectant: it draws water into the top layer of your skin, so it feels softer, calmer and more comfortable.
On the label: panthenol, D-panthenol, 판테놀.
Save this for your next routine. Ingredient Explained, ep. 05.
